topic: P5 AC1018 selected STYLE resource writer-stage and finalization revalidation

writer_stage: Before STYLE rows are emitted, recheck the imported STYLE_CONTROL/STYLE source pair and the same-import typed STYLE/APPID snapshots.
After STYLE rows are staged, require exactly one emitted source STYLE row, TABLES identity, and owner handle 0x3. Any failure marks the active DXF write failed.
finalization: Before dxfRW atomically publishes output, recheck the selected source pair and typed snapshot.
Require the completed emitted STYLE row to retain its source-to-output identity, record type, TABLES section, and STYLE table owner 0x3.
implementation.claim_limit: These checks do not admit output or waive other source-integrity, resource-closure, strict-output, ordering, font-semantic, consumer, or support gates.

assertions: Source pair binds after complete import.
STYLE and APPID mutation are refused and restoration succeeds.
Truncated scratch copy publishes no source receipt; retry with original bytes succeeds.
existing_physical_source_diagnostic.scope_limit: The diagnostic validates source binding and import retry. It does not call fileExport, execute the new writer-stage/finalization checks, prove serialized STYLE field equality, or perform DXF readback.

remaining: Exercise the staged/finalization guard with a source-bound export that reaches STYLE and the pre-commit callback.
Prove exact STYLE output bytes/fields and fresh ASCII/Binary readback under the selected output profile.
Close ordered APPID/STYLE and remaining LTYPE dependencies, font meaning, producer breadth, and whole-source integrity before any output or support promotion.
